title: 5.7 Inverse of a Function

icans: I can find the inverse of a linear function.
I can find the inverse of a nonlinear function, restricting the domain when needed.
I can verify that two functions are inverses.

vocab: functions that __________ each other; f⁻¹ reverses the inputs and outputs of f
__________ x and y, then solve for y
the inverse of f is a ___________ when no horizontal line crosses the graph of f more than once

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: Let f(x) = 2x + 3. Solve y = f(x) for x. Then find the input when the output is −7.

notes: Finding an inverse: To find an inverse: replace f(x) with y, _______________ x and y, then solve for _______________.
Graphs of inverses: The graphs of f and f⁻¹ are reflections in the line _______________.

blocks.stem: Find the inverse of f(x) = 3x − 1. Then graph f and f⁻¹.

notes: Horizontal line test: the inverse of f is a function when no horizontal line crosses the graph of f more than _______________.
Verifying inverses: To verify that f and g are inverses, show that _______________ = x and _______________ = x.

blocks.stem: Find the inverse of f(x) = x² + 2, x ≥ 0. Why is the restriction needed?

tickets.stem: Find the inverse of f(x) = x³ − 4.
